data.body: Closed in_progress→closed (class: regression) via the local CLI from the worktree — the MCP server's code clone was stale (HEAD predated the merge, so its referencing-commit scan could not see 05be3a4dc6e4); the gate's own guidance names the local-checkout store as the recovery path. Completion-verifier attestation signed at 05be3a4dc6e4; plan-review + completion-verifier attestations both on the ticket. Wall-times observed: plan-review ~2.2 min; LLM-Review +1 ~6 min after push; Verified +1 ~25 min; completion verifier ~8.4 min; close ~4.4 min (reused verification). Worktree fix-enrich-producer removed.
